name: Cvent
description: Let agents read your Cvent events: who was invited and who registered, attended or declined, each event's invitation lists and its exhibitors and sponsors. For reconciling RSVPs and matching delegates to sponsors.
identity: A Cvent REST API application (machine to machine). It reads with the scopes you give its workspace, across every event in your Cvent account.

setup.title: Create a REST API workspace
setup.body: You need a Cvent administrator for this. Give the workspace only the read scopes below. If you are not a developer on it yourself, invite yourself (or whoever finishes setup) under Developers. This connection works with Cvent accounts in the North American data center.

link.label: Cvent: inviting developers to your workspace

click: In Cvent, hover over the global navigation and select Admin, then under Integrations select REST API.
Select + Create Workspace, name it Agents, tick only the scopes below, then Save.
On the Developers tab, select + Invite Developers, enter the email of whoever finishes setup, select the Agents workspace, then Send.

setup.title: Create a machine to machine application
setup.body: Sign in to the Cvent Developer Portal as that developer and create an application in the Agents workspace with the same scopes. Copy its client ID and client secret for the form below.

link.label: Cvent: making your first API call

click: In the Cvent Developer Portal, go to Applications and select Create application.
Enter a name such as Agents, select Machine to machine, assign the scopes below, then Save.
Select View applications and copy the Client ID and Client secret.

setup.title: Check what people agreed to
setup.body: Attendee and contact records hold names, emails, companies and registration answers. Make sure your event privacy notices allow agents to read them, and give contact lookups only to agents that need them.
click: Ask your privacy or events team whether attendee data may be read by AI agents.

capabilities.label: Read events and attendees
capabilities.description: List and read events, list attendees (invitees, registrants and their status, invitation list and check-in), read one attendee, and list an event's invitation lists.
capabilities.note: Reaches every event in the account unless you keep an agent to chosen events.

capabilities.label: Read exhibitors and sponsors
capabilities.description: List an event's exhibitors and sponsors, with their sponsorship level, and the event's sponsorship levels.

capabilities.label: Look up contacts
capabilities.description: Read a contact's name, email, company and title from your Cvent address book.
capabilities.note: Contacts are account-wide, not limited to chosen events.

limits.label: Events
limits.help: Optional: only these Cvent events (their ids). Event and attendee lists must then be filtered to them, such as id eq '<id>' for events and event.id eq '<id>' for attendees. Leave empty for every event.

revoke: In the Cvent Developer Portal, go to Applications and delete the application (turn off Termination Protection first if it is on). Agents lose access to Cvent at once.

tools.name: cvent_list_events
tools.description: List events, newest changes first unless sorted. Filter with Cvent's filter syntax, e.g. title contains 'Summit' and start ge '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

filter.description: Cvent filter, e.g. status eq 'Active' (fields: id, title, code, start, end, status, format, venue.address.city)

token.description: The next page's cursor, from the previous answer

tools.name: cvent_get_event
tools.description: Read one event by its id: dates, venue, status, capacity, planners and custom fields.

tools.name: cvent_list_attendees
tools.description: List attendees (invitees and registrants) with their status, invitation list, registration type and check-in. Filter to one event with event.id eq '<id>'; add status eq 'Accepted' (or Declined, Invited, No Response, Cancelled) to reconcile RSVPs.

filter.description: Cvent filter, e.g. event.id eq '<id>' and invitationList.id eq '<id>' (fields: event.id, invitationList.id, registrationType.id, checkedIn, registeredAt)

token.description: The next page's cursor, from the previous answer

tools.name: cvent_get_attendee
tools.description: Read one attendee by id, with their registration answers.

tools.name: cvent_list_invitation_lists
tools.description: List an event's invitation lists, the waves invitees are grouped in.

token.description: The next page's cursor, from the previous answer

tools.name: cvent_list_exhibitors
tools.description: List an event's exhibitors and sponsors, with whether each is a sponsor and its sponsorship level.

token.description: The next page's cursor, from the previous answer

tools.name: cvent_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact by id: name, email, company, title and work address.
